question: By what means is efficacy attributed in this address to the fair-faced one?
premises: An instrument is indicated by this.
That instrument is specified as mere knowledge.
It is further specified as what has been heard.
The address is made to the fair-faced one.
inference: By this mere knowledge, namely what has been heard, effect is attributed in the address to the fair-faced one.
plain_english: By this mere knowledge, by what has been heard, O fair-faced one.
